# SDI_NoC_Fabric

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-23

## Definition
A software-defined interconnect (SDI) fabric integrated with network-on-chip (NoC) mechanisms for reconfigurable on-wafer communication. This fabric is central to TCC research because it unifies topology control and packet routing for scalable many-core and chiplet systems.
